trust_decision.summary: MailPreviewController::findPreview() lets the request pick the class and the method it invokes: the preview name from the route is passed through App::className(..., 'Mailer/Preview'), a name containing a namespace separator is accepted as a fully-qualified class, and the result is instantiated and called as $mailPreview->$email() with no check that it is a MailPreview; the published fix rejects backslashes in the preview name and requires is_subclass_of($realClass, MailPreview::class).

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names MailPreview, and the only reflection in the repository is validEmail()'s ReflectionClass/ReflectionMethod pair (lines 91-102), so a reader looks there first; the class-selection flaw the fix closes is one file away in MailPreviewController::findPreview().

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP GET /debug-kit/mail-preview/preview/* and /debug-kit/mail-preview/preview -> MailPreviewController::email() (public controller action)
fix_sites.module_kind: controller (plugin web UI, gated on Configure::read('debug') at src/Controller/DebugKitController.php:38)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists; the nearest dismissal a solver could reach for is that the whole feature is dev-only, refused unless debug mode is on (src/Controller/DebugKitController.php:38-40).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Plugin-qualified previews must keep resolving: ?plugin=DebugkitTestPlugin with the short name TestMailerPreview resolves to DebugkitTestPlugin\Mailer\Preview\TestMailerPreview, whose class name always contains backslashes, so a fix that rejected backslashes after resolution (or required an App-namespace class) would break every plugin preview.

O6_input_shapes: short preview name used as-is (TestMailerPreview) with an optional ?plugin= prefix
fully-qualified class name containing namespace separators (Cake\Utility\Inflector) taken as the class to instantiate
class that resolves under the Mailer/Preview lookup path but does not extend MailPreview (Invalid)

O7_producer.where: config/routes.php:46-47 (route params name/method) and src/Controller/MailPreviewController.php:106-116 (action plus ?plugin= query)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The index listing resolves every *Preview.php basename through App::className(..., 'Mailer/Preview') and instantiates it at line 211 with no subclass check; a sibling route that shows one preview by a request-supplied name would reuse exactly this lookup.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding a JSON or single-preview detail view next to the existing listing would naturally reuse getMailPreviewClasses()/App::className and pass the name in from the query string, as findPreview already does.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A PanelsController route that renders a panel chosen by request-supplied class name would resolve it with App::className($class, 'Panel', 'Panel') and instantiate it at PanelRegistry.php:90, the same class-selection mechanism with only a return-type check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Panels are pluggable classes named by config; letting the debug toolbar pick a panel by name from the URL is a natural feature and the registry already does resolve-then-new.
